title: Resident Notice: Disputing an Ancillary Charge (Ancillary and Optional Services Billing)
content:
A resident may dispute an Ancillary and Optional Services Billing charge within 60 calendar days after the statement date, and a dispute is resolved within 10 business days. Both periods are the same in every ancillary account tier, from Ancillary Account, Medicare Part A Consolidated Billing through Ancillary Account, Hospice Election.

| Period | Length |
|---|---|
| Dispute window | Within 60 calendar days after the statement date |
| Resolution of a dispute | Within 10 business days |

## Dated illustrations (hypothetical)

- Statement dated 4 June 2026, dispute raised 21 July 2026: 47 calendar days after the statement date, within the 60-day window.
- Statement dated 4 June 2026, dispute raised 19 August 2026: 76 calendar days after the statement date, beyond the 60-day window.

The window counts calendar days; the resolution period counts business days.
